Your body takes on the essence of the ten Hells. You gain greater darkvision, immunity to fire, resistance 5 to physical damage (except silver) and poison damage, and weakness 5 to holy. Damage you deal has the unholy trait. Once during the duration, you can cast 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Translocate] as a divine innate spell.
